Zero dependency on the legacy repository; operation proven with it absent
Read-only legacy audit and salvage ledger
Requirements ledger and implementation map
Implementation metadata on every substantial package
Twins = truth, Model2 = belief, Model1 = decision; no truth in deployment-equivalent inference
Twin1 scrapped; no obsolete architecture identifiers; no extra subsystem
Simulator hidden entity ID never an inference feature or belief ID
Scenario and WorldEntity versioned schemas with shared-scenario consistency
TruthState separated from the public schema surface
Observation and Evidence schemas (evidence is not belief)
BeliefCell, BeliefMessage, BeliefQuery, BeliefRevision schemas
MissionState and ResourceState schemas
SystemHealth, RobotState, RobotConfig, RobotCapabilities schemas
CommunicationState and LinkState schemas
Global machine IDs (UUIDv7), deterministic factory for replay

Common time semantics, clock domains, acquisition vs creation time, asynchronous sensors
Large payloads by content-addressed reference only
Four-channel uncertainty UA/UE/UC/UO, never a single confidence scalar, responsive to inputs
Property-level knowledge status OBSERVED/INFERRED/PREDICTED/UNKNOWN/MIXED
First-class provenance DAG; command -> ... -> raw observation trace
Evidence is not belief; ECMER emits evidence only
One RobotHardwareInterface for simulated and physical robot; no adapter branching upstream
RobotConfig with sourced parameters; missing physical facts stay OPEN
Gateway rejects expired or future-issued commands

Only the gateway calls RobotHardwareInterface.send
Missing/mismatched safety authorization and invalid actuator sets rejected
Hardware control defaults OFF; physical run impossible without every prerequisite

ECMER encoders, fusion, quality head, missing modalities, staged training E1-E4, baselines/ablations
Deterministic candidate retrieval, learned scorer, NO_MATCH
BUO: trust != innovation, contradiction memory, uncertainty update, no artificial certainty
Relational propagation labelled INFERRED with provenance; anti-contamination
Temporal dynamics on physical delta_t; baselines first; temporal surprise
Working graph, persistent store, evidence archive, full lifecycle, CC-09 reset
Abstract synthetic hidden-state sandbox and CORE-* experiments vs baselines
Masked loss zero denominator; padding/permutation invariance
Twin2S canonical geometry, observability truth, OCPWE controls, counterfactual worlds
Model2S persistent spatial belief, observed/inferred/unknown, pose uncertainty, free-space evidence
Twin2T hierarchy, corrosion + fatigue with validity masks, MCDE coupling, interventions
Model2T persistent structural belief, direct vs propagated support, TCDP constrained propagation
Twin2E fields + entities, MEIFE, disturbances, counterfactuals
Model2E separate entity/field beliefs and CEFD coupling with provenance
Asynchronous versioned bus, availability states, failure isolation, cross-domain context only
Children never mutate each other; typed uncertain cross-domain relations; biofouling != corrosion
6-DOF underwater dynamics, thruster/sensor/power models, fault injection, validity level L1
Unity V2 C# project (8 modules) and Python bridge adapter
Conventional estimator baseline with covariance and health; consumes RHI only
Waypoint, global/local planning, obstacle avoidance, trajectory, station keeping, pipeline following, standoff
Classical PID baseline; allocation from RobotConfig geometry with saturation/deadzone/asymmetry/faults
Deterministic Safety Supervisor overrides autonomy; no hard-coded surface action
Model1/EGDC: claim graph, grounded proposals, closed action vocabulary, deterministic constraints, UIR
MCBR: InformationNeed -> ObservationPlan, cause-specific strategies, feasibility before ranking, baselines, never moves the robot
BAAC: receiver model, semantic deltas, progressive fidelity, store-and-forward, channel simulator, baselines
One shared scenario feeds all twins with shared world-entity IDs; impossible worlds rejected
Twin2S -> sim -> sensors -> ECMER -> Model2S persistent spatial belief, no leakage
Autonomous movement on estimated state; nav benchmarks
Structural inspection with partial observations and persistent uncertain 2T state
